{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print("Number of QA orders:", num_qa_orders)

# Verify the premise: there are six QA orders with value 999999.99
assert num_qa_orders == 6, f"Expected 6 QA orders, found {num_qa_orders}"
print("Premise verified: there are exactly 6 QA orders with value 999999.99")

# Check if any QA order has converted=1
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]
num_qa_converted = len(qa_converted)
print("Number of QA orders with converted=1:", num_qa_converted)

# The contract specifies the population is 'all orders in the dataset', so we must include all orders
# Compute the stratified difference in conversion rates, including all orders
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to verify imbalance
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n", crosstab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
conv_rates = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(4)
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:\n", conv_rates)

# Compute the weighted average difference (stratified)
weighted_diff = 0
for segment in df['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = df[df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    conv_email = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    conv_paid_search = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = conv_email - conv_paid_search
    count = len(subset)
    weighted_diff += diff * count
    print(f"Segment {segment}: email={conv_email:.4f}, paid_search={conv_paid_search:.4f}, diff={diff:.4f}")

weighted_diff /= len(df)
print(f"Weighted average difference (stratified): {weighted_diff:.4f}")

# Also compute raw difference for comparison
raw_diff = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()['email'] - df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()['paid_search']
print(f"Raw difference (unadjusted): {raw_diff:.4f}")

# Return the stratified difference
weighted_diff"}
